name: Constitutional Referendum and Popular Consultation of Ecuador in 2018
content: Problems and Purpose Ecuador's 2018 constitutional referendum and popular consultation was an electoral process in which citizens were asked about the possibility of reforming the constitution and other issues of national interest. Background History and Context At the end of 2017, President Lenin Moreno announced the consultation and called on interested citizens to send questions for its analysis and possible incorporation. Organizing, Supporting, and Funding EntitiesKnow who organized or funded this initiative? Help uscomplete this section!Participant Recruitment and Selection In Ecuador, suffrage is mandatory for all citizens authorized to vote before the National Electoral Council and failure to do so is subject to economic sanctions. Methods and Tools UsedKnow what methods or tools were used? Help uscomplete this section!What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The vote achieved the participation of 82.1% of Ecuadorians. The vote consisted of seven questions for the approval or rejection by the citizens on the issues of corruption, reelection, participation, sexual crimes against children and adolescents, and land and natural protected areas. For both the referendum and the popular consultation, the "yes" vote was overwhelmingly selected on all questions. Influence, Outcomes, and EffectsKnow what influence and effects this initiative had?
